# Axiom - Financial Services Static Data System

> A modular monolith financial services platform for managing static data including countries, currencies, entities,
> financial instruments, accounts, and settlement instructions. Built with Go (Gin/Fiber/GORM), Next.js, PostgreSQL,
> and RabbitMQ with integrated Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) data acquisition from GLEIF.

Axiom implements a CQRS architecture pattern with JWT authentication, comprehensive API documentation, and
multi-environment deployment support (dev, UAT, production). Key features include automated LEI data synchronization,
WebSocket support, rate limiting, Prometheus metrics, and containerized deployment via Docker Compose.

## Contributing

- [Branching Strategy](docs/contributing/BRANCHING_STRATEGY.md): Branch naming, promotion workflow,
  and protection rules (dev → uat → prod); includes automated promotion behaviour at all levels
- [Branch Setup Script](scripts/setup-branches.sh): gh CLI script to create and protect strategic
  branches
- [CI Workflow](.github/workflows/ci.yml): Unified CI pipeline keyed off branch names for
  environment detection (main, dev, uat, prod)
- [Nightly Promotion Workflow](.github/workflows/promote-main-to-dev.yml): Scheduled workflow that
  opens a promotion PR from main → dev each night to prevent branch drift
- [Weekly Promotion Workflow](.github/workflows/promote-dev-to-uat.yml): Scheduled workflow that
  opens a promotion PR from dev → uat every Monday
- [Monthly Promotion Workflow](.github/workflows/promote-uat-to-prod.yml): Scheduled workflow that
  opens a promotion PR from uat → prod on the 1st of each month
